---
title: "SDS 341: Algorithms for Decision Making"
Semester: "2026-2027 Fall"
---

**Course Description**: This course introduces students to the subject of machine learning. 
The primary focus is the development and application of powerful machine learning algorithms 
applied to complex, real-world data. Topics covered include linear regression, nearest neighbor models, 
k-means clustering, shrinkage methods, decision trees and forests, boosting, bagging, support vector machines, 
and hierarchical clustering. Applications are taken from a wide variety of disciplines, including biology, 
economics, public policy, public health, and sports.
